heading_en: Treatment Where a Guarantee or Credit Derivative Is Attached to a Corporate, etc. Exposure
summary_ja: 事業法人等向けエクスポージャーに保証又はクレジット・デリバティブが付された場合の信用リスク削減効果の勘案方法(基礎的・先進的内部格付手法、標準的手法の区分)と準用規定を定める。
summary_en: Sets how the effect of a guarantee or credit derivative on a corporate, etc. exposure is recognized, by the approach applied to the guarantor, and the provisions applied mutatis mutandis.
paragraphs: Notwithstanding the preceding Article, where a guarantee or credit derivative is attached to a corporate, etc. exposure, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach may apply the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets, the PD and the LGD corresponding to the guarantee or credit derivative to the guaranteed portion of the guaranteed claim or the portion of the underlying claim for which protection is provided; provided, however, that where the approach applied in calculating the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the direct exposure to the guarantor or protection provider is the standardized approach, the guaranteed portion of the guaranteed claim or the portion of the underlying claim for which protection is provided may be deemed a direct exposure to that guarantor or protection provider.

Where a guarantee or credit derivative is attached to a corporate, etc. exposure that does not fall under the exposures listed in the items of Article 123, paragraph (2) (hereinafter referred to as a "corporate, etc. exposure to which the advanced internal ratings-based approach can be applied"), an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach may take into account the credit risk mitigation effect of the guarantee or credit derivative by the method specified in each of the following items, according to the category of approach applied in calculating the amount of credit risk-weighted assets of the direct exposure to the guarantor or protection provider listed in that item. (i) Advanced internal ratings-based approach: a method of applying, to the guaranteed portion of the guaranteed claim or the portion of the underlying claim for which protection is provided, either PD or LGD that takes the guarantee or credit derivative into account. (ii) Foundation internal ratings-based approach: a method of applying, to the guaranteed portion of the guaranteed claim or the portion of the underlying claim for which protection is provided, the formula for the amount of credit risk-weighted assets, the PD and the LGD corresponding to the guarantee or credit derivative. (iii) Standardized approach: a method of deeming the guaranteed portion of the guaranteed claim or the portion of the underlying claim for which protection is provided to be a direct exposure to that guarantor or protection provider.

Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach applies, to a corporate, etc. exposure to which the advanced internal ratings-based approach can be applied and to which estimated LGD applies, an LGD that takes the guarantee or credit derivative into account to the guaranteed portion of the guaranteed claim or the portion of the underlying claim for which protection is provided under item (i) of the preceding paragraph, it may take into account the credit risk mitigation effect of a first-to-default credit derivative.

The provisions of Article 59, Articles 94 through 97, Articles 101 through 108, Article 111 and Article 113 shall apply mutatis mutandis where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach applies paragraph (1) (excluding the proviso). In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in those provisions shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach".

The provisions of Article 59, Articles 94 through 98, Articles 101 through 108, Article 111 and Article 113 shall apply mutatis mutandis where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach applies the proviso to paragraph (1) or paragraph (2) (limited to the part relating to item (iii)). In this case, the term "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in those provisions shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach".
